history_methods.counter: rate(source[1d]) per original series before summing; minimum 360 samples per 24h UTC day. Query return is rate/second, not interval total.
history_methods.sampling: Daily non-overlapping 24h windows ending at 00:00:00 UTC (86,400s). No sub-24h windows or intra-day updates.
history_methods.coverage: Window eligible count must be >=90% of max(endpoint available population, largest eligible count in preceding 31 days). Missing remains null; available series absent before metric introduction.
history_methods.custom_directory: Require all 3 previous-hop series to meet 360 samples per 24h UTC day for each relay+request type; count relays after that gate.
history_methods.baseline: Historical per-day fleet rate/mean divided by coarsened eligible relay count. Reference mean is unweighted mean of those normalized daily windows; normalizing avoids fleet-size multiplication but does not remove changes in relay capacity, roles, build or traffic.
history_methods.reference_line: mean_per_relay × current relevant relay count; units match fleet chart.
history_methods.percentile: Midrank empirical CDF: 100×(less+0.5×equal)/N, comparing current normalized 24h UTC day against historical 24h UTC days. No severity inferred; all-zero reference/current reports null rank and flat_zero.
history_methods.reference_exclusion: Reference windows fit wholly inside the 18-month window; reference end is at least 24 hours (one full UTC day) before snapshot end.
history_methods.first_window: Raw retained TSDB starts May 18 2025; first complete 00:00 UTC daily window ends May 20 2025.
history_methods.source_scope: Core native histories queried from May 19 2025; custom and .15 directory counters queried from Oct 1 2026 where source introduction evidence locates deployment in October. No pre-introduction zeros fabricated.
history_methods.reference_refresh: Frozen once per UTC day: prior 18 calendar months ending at snapshot start (previous UTC midnight), matching the daily publication schedule.
history_methods.historical_averages: Arithmetic means of qualifying complete daily fleet values, in plot units. Equal weight per measured day; missing days excluded. All time uses all retained daily observations. Last 30 days uses 30 days ending at snapshot end (>=90% / 27 days required). Last 6 months uses six calendar months ending at snapshot end (>=90% required). Current 24h comparison rulers normalize per reporting relay.
history_methods.coarsening: Deterministic dir-spec coarsening at snapshot boundaries: standalone public relay, flag, cohort and dircache_cohort counts <8 are floored to 0 and counts >=8 are rounded to the nearest multiple of 8 (preserving classified <= total and role <= non_middle), while partitioned build, cohort and middle_only/non-middle role breakdowns distribute multiples of 8 by largest remainder so parts sum to the coarsened total (individual parts may differ from nearest-multiple rounding). open_circuits daily means are rounded to the nearest 100 circuits, then to 3 significant digits; hsdir_fetches, hsdir_uploads, introduction_rejections, and directory_requests hs_get/hs_post are binned to 0.001/s, then rounded to 3 significant digits; other counter series suppress <8 events/day, bin to 8-event increments, and round rates to 3 significant digits; and non-sensitive gauge means (directory_waiting) floor <0.05 to 0, quantize [0.05, 1) to 0.1, and round >=1 to 3 significant digits.
